project.name: Braehead of Lunan
project.boundarySource: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Full strict-boundary visitor audit. Braehead of Lunan remains selector-only. HES reconciliation confirms all three listed structures and restores official construction evidence: Lunan Lodge 1783, Nether Dysart Doocot 17th century and the Lunan Lodge sundial dated 1830. Seven undated NRHE context records remain map-hidden. The recognised elevated Lunan Bay outlook and NCN Route 1 give the hamlet some landscape character, but there is no dedicated viewpoint parking, visitor trail or coherent settlement visit. Upper Dysart Larder, Lunan Bay beach, Red Castle and their facilities lie outside the boundary and are excluded. Angus-wide full audit completed 2026-09-01: all six visitor categories, the four named commercial trail providers, current official/conventional routes, strict-boundary scoring and local HES/NRHE integrity were checked.
